name: Lymphocytes (%)
summary: Lymphocytes are white blood cells that fight infections. This value is the share of your white blood cells that are lymphocytes.

high.meaning: A higher share of lymphocytes is common during or after viral infections.

low.meaning: A lower share can happen with stress, steroid medicines or when other white cells are raised by a bacterial infection.
commonCauses: Bacterial infection raising other white cells

sources.title: An epigenetic biomarker of aging for lifespan and healthspan
